title: Commit rules contract
description: Scopes and the requirement-reference rule for the commit-msg hook (scripts/git/commit-config.ts) and check-commits.mjs. Every key is optional; a missing key takes the default.

scopeFolders.description: Folders that give scopes: '<folder>/*' (each visible sub-folder name) or '<folder>' (its own name). Default: the workspace globs when multi-package, then src/features/* and src/*.

extraScopes.description: Scopes added to the folder scopes and the fixed scopes (repo, deps, docs, ci, tooling, e2e, release, skills).

requirementRef.description: null: off (a Spec-Change trailer still names a requirement: #123, TASK-12, spec 4.2, issue 31). An object: the pattern a requirement reference matches, and whether feat and fix bodies must name one.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression source (u flag), for example \bTASK-\d+\b.

exemptScopes.description: Scopes whose feat and fix bodies need no reference. Default: the fixed scopes.
